mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.name, w.description, w.is_default AS isDefault, COUNT(e.id) AS entryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.next_review_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dueCount, w.create_time AS createTime FROM learning_wordbook w LEFT JOIN learning_wordbook_entry e ON e.wordbook_id = w.id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted = 0 GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.description, w.is_default, w.create_time ORDER BY w.is_default DESC, w.create_time ASC
